collections.name: city-reference-crosswalk
collections.scope: Preserve text-rendition/access qualifications or catalogue-reference-candidate status; no canonical reading, linguistic join or scientific acceptance.

collections.name: city-edition-page-check

collections.scope: Preserve actual page/snapshot scope. No canonical readings, physical joins, linked annotation delivery or human acceptance inferred.

collections.name: visual-source-routes
collections.scope: Actual consulted pages/responses only; no unique-object counts, clause/line equivalence, linked annotation delivery, new canonical readings or independent review.

collections.name: historical-visual-presentations
collections.scope: Six historical source presentations, not six physical objects or independent witnesses. No admitted sign geometry.

artifacts.role: bounded source access or structure check

scholarly_limits: Bibliographic citations marked direct_edition_checked=false remain uninspected leads. Secondary label matching does not certify chronology or physical object identity.
Attribution review inspects pinned native packets, not underlying sources afresh. Its cases and apparatus notes are not independent witnesses or an alternative-pair total.
The2026-10-17 source-study collection adds bounded documentary/author assertions only. Read its result_status, source rights and remaining_gates; prepared review packets grant no human acceptance.
snapshot_commit_scope: Mixed inputs retain their per-artifact anchors. New original review artifacts are byte-pinned and identified by published repository history, not assigned to an earlier commit.
